sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which 
must be performed every 
six months 
as indicated by M6 in the title block.

This Pump transfers raw 
water from Nile to the water treatment plant.

The first draft is initiated 
and tested 
by eng. Mohammed Abd El Kader, reviewed by maintenance manager eng. 
Mohammed Farag, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality 
control eng. Abouda Elbana, approved by eng. Awad Fathy: head 
sector of Talkha 2x210MW 
power 
station , 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector.

Technical 
specification

Type of pump 125 CVEV 
265 
15 / 2LN
Design: Vertical centrifugal pump

Pump capacity 75.6 
m3/h (21 L/s)

Specific energy 35 م 
مرحاض. (345 جول/كجم)

Pump Speed 1480 
r.p.m.

Bearing Type 
 7210/T - 2209
احتياطات السلامة

تصريح عمل 
 يجب أن يتم إصدارها ويجب أن يحملها موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون 
 فئة السلامة،

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks must be surrounding the work area is required,

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump 
 motor.

Disconnect electric terminals of the pump 
 motor.

ال
pump must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.
تأكد من أن المضخة يجب أن يتم تصريفها بالكامل.

مجموعة أدوات الصيانة الكاملة
سائل تنظيف، سحب يدوي.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Vibrometer, straight edge, Rugs.
العمل المراد تنفيذه
Pump In Operation

Measure vibrations level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do (if it is needed).

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn- out components 
 (if it is needed).

sections.text: Pump Out Of Operation

Check alignment and compare it with the 
 setting value.

Check bolts fixation, then re-tightens it (if 
 it is needed).

Check the validity of oil and add or change it 
 (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and re-packing (if it 
 is needed).

Check flanges for leaking and re-tight ( if it 
 is needed ) .

Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).
